issue.title: validation failed comes back with empty details for a misspelt field
issue.body:
A typo in our client sent `PATCH /api/v1/reports/:id` with `"categroies"`
instead of `"categories"`. The response was

    400 {"error":"validation failed","details":{}}

so nothing said which field was wrong, and it took us an hour to spot. When we
send a known field with the wrong type, `details` names it, for example
`{"name":["Expected string, received number"]}`. `PATCH /users/me` with an
unknown field gives the same empty `details`.

input.title: Report unknown-field errors in details for validation failures
input.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

The ZodError branch of errorHandler returns only err.flatten().fieldErrors. Zod reports unrecognised keys (from strict schemas) as issues at the root with no path, so they land in formErrors and never reach details, which comes back as {}. Change this branch so that root-level issues (formErrors, or the unrecognized_keys messages) are also included in details, so a misspelt field such as "categroies" is named in the response.
